name: pi-permission-system
notes:
Forked from gotgenes/pi-packages; local wrapper-floor rework (fallback mode) intentionally diverges from upstream. v32.1.0 sync adopted upstream's region-scoped tool-surface removal for custom system prompts (#919) and configurable permission-dialog hotkeys via permissionDialogKeys (#927), while preserving the fork's named permission profiles, session role layer, wrapper floors, and forwarded-decision broadcast. The bash salvage merge keeps fork's parseProgram recursion (wrapperFloors) alongside upstream's withSalvagedRoots. 2026-09-19 conflict-surface pass: whitespace churn reverted to upstream bytes (fake-ts-node.ts byte-identical; service.ts keeps only 3 re-export lines; forwarded-request-server.ts and permission-manager.ts import blocks restored; extension-config/permissions-service/shell-tool-alias tests keep only their semantic lines). Fork test describes moved to fork-only test files (config-loader.fork, config-schema.fork, forwarded-request-server.fork, permission-events.fork, profiles-gating.fork). The duplicated parseCommandUnits closure now lives once in fork-only src/access-intent/bash/wrapper-parse.ts (makeParseProgram factory) consumed by program.ts and sync-commands.ts. Orphan src/denial-messages.ts (a revived copy of the upstream-dissolved module, zero references) deleted. Never let biome/prettier reformat upstream files in this package — keep upstream formatting byte-stable. 2026-09-19 P2 pass: the ~450-line wrapper-classification block moved out of src/access-intent/bash/command-enumeration.ts into fork-only src/access-intent/bash/wrapper-floors.ts (only classifyWrapperCommand is exported; makeCommandUnit now passes text/words/parseProgram so there is no runtime cycle — upstream keeps only the import + the classify-then-fall-through seam; do NOT re-inline on sync), and the profile-scope block in permission-manager.resolvePermissions moved to fork-only src/policy/profile-scope.ts (resolveProfileScope; cacheKey/env-freeze machinery stays). 2026-09-21 add-project-scoped-profiles: permission side now supports project-defined profiles. Fork-only src/policy/profile-scope.ts: extended ProfileScopeSelection with projectProfiles/projectTrusted, new resolveProfileScopes returning dual-layer [profile-global, profile-project] scope array + invalidProfileName + warnings (global layer first, trusted project layer second; projectTrusted=false collapses projectProfiles to empty; per-layer non-emptiness via normalizeFlatPermissionValue Object.keys > 0; untrusted-project warning built when projectTrusted===false && projectProfiles non-empty), plus compat wrapper resolveProfileScope folding layers low-to-high. src/policy/permission-manager.ts seam (+86/-3 baseline, now +106/-3): resolvePermissions block swapped to consume resolveProfileScopes spread (warnings plumbed into ResolvedPermissions.warnings and getConfigIssues), private projectTrusted field derived from configureForCwd (undefined/null/'' => false, default true). src/policy/rule.ts: RuleOrigin union appends 'profile-global'/'profile-project' (recurring cost; 'profile' remains the selection/launcher-env named-ruleset origin). src/config/config-loader.ts: the fork-added allowProfiles rejection ('profiles key is only supported in the global configuration') is DELETED (shrinking the +63/-3 fork edit to +18/-0 confined to two mergeUnifiedConfigs blocks: wrapperFloors enum loop + profiles override-replaces-base 'combined at resolution time, not folded here'); config-schema.ts unifiedConfigSchema profilesSchema already accepts project profiles. Fork-only src/config/project-profile-probe.ts: countProjectConfigProfiles(cwd) silently counts <cwd>/.pi/extensions/pi-permission-system/config.json profiles keys (tolerant on absent/unreadable/malformed) + untrustedProjectProfilesWarning(N); PermissionSession.refreshConfig emits the UI-notify channel (ctx param since handleSessionStart calls refreshConfig before activate; lastProjectProfileWarning dedup field). Selection-side unchanged: projectScopedProfileTrustError guard (kind sandbox|permission) still exact-match trustedCwd===effectiveCwd. Divergence clusters: policy/profile-scope.ts (fork-only), policy/permission-manager.ts (+106/-3), policy/rule.ts (+8/-1), config/config-loader.ts (+18/-0), config/policy-loader.ts (+26/-2), session/permission-session.ts (+53/-0), config/config-store.ts (+3/-0), config/project-profile-probe.ts (fork-only). Re-apply on each sync: dual-layer resolveProfileScopes + manager spread, RuleOrigin union members, probe import + refreshConfig warning, loadProjectConfig profiles spread.
v34.0.0 sync (2026-09-25, fork 1.3.0): root-commit record stays 26caf78f3; squash trailer names split commit d42b8b08 (monorepo mirror split via pp-split at ~/workspaces/upstreams/gotgenes-pi-packages, tree verified against <root>:packages/pi-permission-system). Adopted upstream: redirect-target path-rule enforcement (breaking), MCP prefix-named server rules + true last-match-wins, pi>=0.86 section-shape tool surface (keeps project Guidelines), config-issue reporter, status-bar sync via syncPermissionSystemStatus(#933) — now coexisting in refreshConfig with the fork's untrusted-project profiles probe; configStore.refresh signature changed to (cwd, projectTrusted) upstream, fork call sites updated. readCommandWords refactored upstream into commandWordNodes — adopted. Fork seams intact: dual-layer resolveProfileScopes + manager spread, RuleOrigin profile-global/profile-project, probe import + refreshConfig warning + lastProjectProfileWarning dedup, wrapper-floors fork-only module. raw-vs-w numstat noise in command-enumeration.ts/CHANGELOG/README/docs is code-move alignment only (fork WrapperKind block sits at different nesting; prettier-ignored package). Tests 4757/4757, typecheck clean.
